origin.basis: Schwalbe is the brand of Ralf Bohle GmbH, Reichshof, Germany (legal notice).

manufacturing.basis: The Schwalbe product pages do not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Schwalbe's European and North American sites give recommended retail prices and send buyers to retailers; mainland China availability not verified.

name: One Plus
positioning: Schwalbe's flat-resistant everyday road tire with SmartGuard, successor to the Durano Plus.
caveats: Weights are for the folding version; wired versions are heavier.
Heavy puncture-protection tire; no lab test recorded.

price_observations.conditions: Recommended retail price on the official product page on 2026-11-01; one tire; retailer prices vary.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other. The wired and folding versions count as the same tire.

reports.summary: Good grip and rolls without noticeable drag at a fair price, but after 3,000 km on asphalt and concrete the tread was covered in holes.
Much heavier than the standard One, but the owner finds it almost completely puncture-proof.

checks.note: The one written review describes only fitting
Wired and folding listings; one review gives no riding detail
Only the earlier Durano Plus was tested
